text:
Maya Chen: quick design review for Security > Data retention + Encryption — flagged a few wording + a11y nits in the Figma file https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123 (comments left). main points below, TL;DR: copy clarity, aria for toggles, focus order, and one contrast badge.
Jordan Patel: thanks! can you paste the exact strings you想 to change? i can whip a small copy PR.
Maya Chen: sure — pasted below, plus a tiny audit-log example.
Maya Chen: 1) Retention label: change from 'Retention' -> 'Retention period (days) — how long logs & call content are stored'. short help text: 'Shorter retention reduces storage costs; required for some compliance regimes.'
Maya Chen: 2) Region dropdown: current placeholder 'Global' is misleading. suggestion: 'Serving region (data residency) — select where inference logs are stored'. tooltip: 'Selecting a region scopes log storage and encryption to that region.'
Maya Chen: 3) KMS toggle & label: current 'Use customer key' is ambiguous. suggestion: 'Use customer-managed encryption key (CMK)'. tooltip: 'Customer-managed keys (CMK) are controlled in your cloud KMS. Use a region-specific CMK to avoid cross-region key access.'
Maya Chen: 4) Audit log copy: we show raw key ids and internal names in the example row. change to human-friendly phrasing and hide raw ids by default. sample entry (sanitized):
Maya Chen: ```
Timestamp: 2026-03-20T14:33:21Z
User: ryan.k@example.com
Action: Export logs
Resource: inference-run-12345
Encryption: Customer-managed key (AWS KMS, us-east-1)
Note: Key id hidden — click to reveal
```
Samir Singh: a11y notes: toggle needs role="switch" and aria-checked on the CMK toggle. keyboard order: after you insert the retention slider the next tabbable control currently jumps to the modal close — needs fix.
Samir Singh: also the 'ENCRYPTED' badge is failing color contrast (AA) at small sizes — change to a darker green or add outline.
Eva Lopez: UX question: do we want to surface a recommended default? e.g., 'Managed key (recommended)' vs 'Customer-managed key (advanced)'. that helps reduce support tickets.
Ryan K: product constraint — if we use 'CMK' term we should also show vendor mapping: 'Customer-managed key (AWS KMS / GCP CMEK / Azure BYOK)'. legal asked we avoid implying cross-cloud support beyond what we actually offer. maybe show provider list only when user picks CMK.
Jordan Patel: good points. i'll open a copy + tiny markup PR with Maya's strings and add the CMK tooltip. Samir — can you add aria notes in the PR description so eng-runtime can pick them up? @design-bot can you snapshot the updated Figma with the retention label and toggle states?
design-bot: Figma snapshot created: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123?node-id=456:789 (latest frame: retention-kms-a11y)
Maya Chen: perfect — Jordan please mark the PR as 'a11y-ready' and ping Samir for review. target: ship to staging before Monday release. :thumbsup:
Ryan K: noted, will verify naming with security/legal before ship.
Jordan Patel: will follow up with a short changelog entry for Console release notes.
Maya Chen: thanks all — small but important fixes. :sparkles:
